title: Ring Fly
summary: A bodyweight chest fly on rings that loads the chest heavily at long length. You adjust the difficulty with your body angle.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Hold the rings at chest height and lean forward with your arms straight and slightly bent.
Let your arms open wide as your chest lowers.
Squeeze your arms back together to rise.

form_cues.cue: Start very upright. It gets hard quickly as you lean further forward.

mistakes.text: Going wider than you can bring back with control.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Upper-chest bias, Better isolation.
